title: Crane Rescue
description: Original Donkey Kong-inspired barrel/ladder arcade foundation: sloped girders, ladder eligibility, telegraphed barrel rolling/drop paths, rescue goal, time bonus, lives, multiple stages, jump-over scoring and cooperative 2P.

license.notes: Original authored implementation and pixel art. No commercial game sprites, ROM data or source copied. Donkey Kong is a reference to the requested mechanic family, not the identity of this game's characters.
